title: Closed localization unit through bounded-below Cech descent
statement:
Let $\mathcal X,\mathcal V,\mathcal Y,\mathcal Z,\mathcal B$ be topoi of sheaves on small sites with module categories over sheaves of commutative rings in fixed larger universes [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $f:\mathcal X\to\mathcal V$, $g:\mathcal V\to\mathcal Y$, and $t:\mathcal B\to\mathcal Y$ be morphisms of ringed topoi with exact module inverse images. Let $h^*:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal V)\rightleftarrows\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal Z):h_*$ be a specified additive adjunction with both functors exact; write $H=h_*h^*$ and $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to H$ for its unit. All module categories are Grothendieck abelian [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], and use ordinary unbounded K-injective derived categories [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories].
Let $v:V\to1_{\mathcal X}$ be an epimorphism of sheaves of sets, $\mathcal X_n=\mathcal X/(V^{\times(n+1)})$ its Cech slices [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], $v_n:\mathcal X_n\to\mathcal X$ their localization morphisms, and $N$ a module sheaf on $\mathcal X$. Put $N_n=v_n^*N$ and $C_n=R(fv_n)_*(N_n[0])$, with the augmented Cech maps. There are natural identifications
$$t^*Rg_*Rf_*(N[0])\cong\operatorname{Tot}_n t^*Rg_*C_n,$$
$$t^*Rg_*H\bigl(Rf_*(N[0])\bigr)\cong\operatorname{Tot}_n t^*Rg_*H(C_n).$$
Here $H$ on derived categories is its termwise exact descent. Each totalization is computed with compatible nonnegative resolutions and the Cech alternating differential; all total degrees have finite diagonals. Under these identifications the actual map
$$t^*Rg_*\bigl(\eta_{Rf_*(N[0])}\bigr)$$
is the totalization of $t^*Rg_*(\eta_{C_n})$. The identifications preserve the augmentation and its restriction-of-sections map and are natural in $N$ and refinements of $v$. Restricting the entire diagram to an object of a small site, using its slice site and pulled-back coefficient ring, gives these same comparisons; the adjunction unit remains the original unit under slice restriction. No claim about arbitrary unbounded product totalizations or about $h^*$ preserving injectives is included.
